title: Jonah and the Sigil
author: Mirabel Voss
blurb: Juniper Eriksen, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
